rites_and_paths.welcome.title: Welcome to Rolflin's Rites & Paths!
rites_and_paths.welcome.classes: Pick a class and a race, level up and unlock branches, abilities and subclasses. Open the class book with %s.
rites_and_paths.welcome.difficulty: Enemies adapt: depending on the players' level or the distance from spawn, they wear better gear, have more health and damage, show up in greater numbers and can be elites with special traits. Tranquility and Challenge potions adjust that difficulty.
rites_and_paths.welcome.remind: Remember to set up the difficulty before you start:
rites_and_paths.welcome.link.hover: Click to open the difficulty settings
Difficulty depends on the class level of nearby players.
rites_and_paths.difficulty.mode.distance: Difficulty only grows the farther you are from the world spawn.
rites_and_paths.difficulty.mode.mixed.de: An average of the players' level and the distance from spawn.
rites_and_paths.difficulty.intensity.off: The mod does not increase difficulty.
rites_and_paths.difficulty.intensity.nor: Increases are as the mod intends.
